WoW: Forever

Paladin

Paladin is a plate-wearing melee fighter that runs on mana, and it is no longer faction-locked. Undead Paladins are new in Forever, with their own class hub in Tirisfal Glades.

Back to top

A guide to the live game, levels 1 to 60. Forever launched on November 4, 2026. Spell levels and numbers are read from the current client, build 1.60.1.70938 with its hotfixes. Class changes are Blizzard's own: the October 15 Paladin deep dive, the November 2 development notes, and the hotfixes through November 11.

Talent builds past 30 are Wowhead's and Icy Veins', published November 4 to 6. Each spec page names them and checks them against the current tree. No raid opens until December 9, 2026, so there are no raid logs and nothing here is measured at level 60.

A hover tooltip can lag a hotfix. Where a tooltip and the prose differ, the prose is right.

Dungeon experience was cut, then partly restored. Dungeon quests reward 50% less extra experience beyond normal quest values, which Blizzard framed as a deliberate reduction in levelling speed. Kills inside dungeons launched at 40% of their Classic Era experience. Blizzard raised that by half on November 8, to 60% of Classic Era, and has said the result fits the rest of the game. The party experience penalty is judged per member, not by the highest-level member.

Dual Specialization is bought at 40. Wowhead reports it comes from your class trainer at level 40 for 50 gold. That is the cheap way to hold a tanking or healing set of talents beside a solo one.

Is Paladin for you?

Play Paladin if you want a melee class that carries its own heals, wears mail from level 1 and plate from 40, and can train for whichever of the three roles a group is short of.

Strengths

  • Heals itself in every spec: Holy LightHoly LightLevel 1 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 9Cast2.5 sec castCost35 ManaRange40 yd rangeHeals a friendly target for 42 to 50. from level 1, Lay on HandsLay on HandsLevel 10 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 3CastInstantRange40 yd rangeCooldown1200 sec cooldownHeals a friendly target for an amount equal to the Paladin's maximum health. Drains all of the Paladin's remaining Mana when used, but does not interrupt Mana regeneration. from 10, Divine ShieldDivine ShieldLevel 34 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 2CastInstantCost75 ManaCooldown300 sec cooldownDuration10 secProtects the paladin from all damage and spells for 10 sec, but reduces all damage you deal by 50%. Applies Forbearance for 60 sec. Cannot be cast while Forbearance is active. from 34
  • Covers all three group roles — Seal of FurySeal of FuryLevel 10 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 7CastInstantCost40 ManaDuration30 secFills you with divine fury for 30 sec, causing melee attacks to deal an additional 6 Holy damage. While a shield is equipped, each attack also grants an absorb shield equal to 50% of the Holy damage dealt. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time. Unleashing this Seal's energy inflicts 32 to 34 Holy damage to an enemy and taunts the target to attack you for 3 sec. taunts from 10, and the heals need no talent points
  • Blessings and auras apply to the whole party, and Blessings now last a full hour
  • Blizzard calls Paladins the strongest single-target healers in the game, and very strong against Undead and Demons

Weaknesses

  • Holy and Protection spend their talent points on healing and threat rather than damage
  • Runs on mana: Holy StrikeHoly StrikeLevel 6 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 8CastInstantCost5 ManaRangeMeleeCooldown10 sec cooldownAn instant strike that causes 25% weapon damage plus an additional 11 to 14 as Holy damage., JudgementJudgementLevel 4 · Spell · HolyCastInstantCost6% of base ManaRange10 yd rangeCooldown10 sec cooldownUnleash the energy of a Seal spell upon an enemy. Does not consume the Seal. Refer to individual Seals for Judgement effect. and ConsecrationConsecrationLevel 20 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantCost135 ManaCooldown8 sec cooldownDuration8 secConsecrates the land beneath the Paladin, doing 16 Holy damage over 8 sec to enemies who enter the area. The first 4 enemies who enter the area will take an additional 32 damage over 8 sec. all draw on the same bar
  • No area damage at all until ConsecrationConsecrationLevel 20 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantCost135 ManaCooldown8 sec cooldownDuration8 secConsecrates the land beneath the Paladin, doing 16 Holy damage over 8 sec to enemies who enter the area. The first 4 enemies who enter the area will take an additional 32 damage over 8 sec. at 20
  • Blizzard's own list of what the class lacks: no interrupt, no way to slow a target, and less reach than its other mana users even with Holy talents

New to this class?

Is the rotation simple? Three buttons: keep a seal up, judge it, strike on cooldown.

Is it forgiving? You heal yourself, wear mail from level 1 and plate from 40, and get Divine ShieldDivine ShieldLevel 34 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 2CastInstantCost75 ManaCooldown300 sec cooldownDuration10 secProtects the paladin from all damage and spells for 10 sec, but reduces all damage you deal by 50%. Applies Forbearance for 60 sec. Cannot be cast while Forbearance is active. at 34.

What carries you while levelling? Retribution carries the damage: Holy StrikeHoly StrikeLevel 6 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 8CastInstantCost5 ManaRangeMeleeCooldown10 sec cooldownAn instant strike that causes 25% weapon damage plus an additional 11 to 14 as Holy damage. from level 6, a two-hander, and ConsecrationConsecrationLevel 20 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantCost135 ManaCooldown8 sec cooldownDuration8 secConsecrates the land beneath the Paladin, doing 16 Holy damage over 8 sec to enemies who enter the area. The first 4 enemies who enter the area will take an additional 32 damage over 8 sec. added at 20.

Does it need a group? No. Every spec trains heals and a taunt, so you can fill whatever a group lacks.

Three things a reader may expect and will not find. Blessing of Sanctuary is not in Forever in either form: nothing trains it, no tree offers it, and Blizzard's dive lists it among the talents Protection lost. Blizzard removed Blessing of LightBlessing of LightTalentCastInstantRange100 yd rangeDuration0.1 sec, and trainers teach neither it nor Greater Blessing of Light. Blizzard's November 2 notes also removed Voice of TruthVoice of TruthLevel 20 · Spell · HolyCastInstantCooldown180 sec cooldownDuration6 secGrants you immunity to Silence and Interrupt effects for 6 sec., the Silence and Interrupt immunity. Wowhead and Icy Veins still list it on pages dated November 4 and 5, and the trainer list read from the current client does not have it.

Which race

Race is the smallest of the choices on this page, well behind spec, gear and knowing your rotation. No race is a wrong answer for levelling (ours, not a source's). Racials decide things in PvP. The ones that matter there break crowd control: Will of the ForsakenWill of the ForsakenTalentCastInstantCooldown120 sec cooldownDuration0.1 secInstantly removes all Charm, Fear and Sleep effects. (Undead, fear, sleep and charm), Will to SurviveWill to SurviveTalentCastInstantCooldown180 sec cooldownInstantly removes all Stun effects. (Human, stuns) and StoneformStoneformTalentCastInstantCooldown180 sec cooldownDuration8 secInstantly removes and grants immunity to all Bleed, Poison, and Disease effects, and reduces all Physical damage taken by 10% for 8 sec. (Dwarf, bleeds, poisons and disease). A free trinket slot is worth more than any damage racial below (ours, not a source's).

Alliance: Human or Dwarf. Human's RuthlessRuthlessTalentCastInstantIncreases your critical strike chance with all spells and attacks by 1%. gives +1% crit to all spells and attacks, which feeds both gearing paths, and The Human SpiritThe Human SpiritTalentCastInstantSpirit increased by 10%. adds 10% Spirit. Dwarf's StoneformStoneformTalentCastInstantCooldown180 sec cooldownDuration8 secInstantly removes and grants immunity to all Bleed, Poison, and Disease effects, and reduces all Physical damage taken by 10% for 8 sec. is a real solo cooldown, and Artisan's PrecisionArtisan's PrecisionTalentCastInstantIncreases your chance to hit with all spells and attacks by 1%. gives +1% hit with spells and attacks.

Horde: Undead, and it is forced, being the only Horde Paladin. It is good anyway (ours, not a source's). CannibalizeCannibalizeTalentCastInstantRangeMeleeCooldown120 sec cooldownWhen activated, regenerates 7% of total Health and 7% of total Mana every 2 sec for 10 sec. Only works on Humanoid or Undead corpses within 5 yds. Any movement, action, or damage taken while Cannibalizing will cancel the effect. now restores 35% health and mana, which on a mana-using melee class is close to a free recovery on every corpse.

Paladin is no longer Alliance-only. Undead Paladins get their own hub at Bandarion Keep in the previously inaccessible Whispering Wood, Tirisfal Glades, and their own level 40 and 60 mount quests.

Quality of life

  • Seals, Blessings and Auras are three separate always-on systems, and new players drop one. Set an aura and forget it. Keep a blessing on yourself. Keep a seal up always: Judgement no longer consumes your seal in Forever, so there is no excuse for letting it lapse.
  • Only one-handed maces are known by default. Every other weapon skill, including all two-handers, must be bought from a weapon master. Polearms from 20.
  • Do the level-20 class quest, which rewards a deliberately over-budgeted weapon. Alliance get Verigan's Fist from The Test of Righteousness. Horde get Wolfsbane, even slower and more powerful, from the chain that opens with Diplomatic Incident in Bandarion Keep. Icy Veins has both chains available from level 20 and sends both through the Deadmines, Shadowfang Keep and Blackfathom Deeps.
  • ConsecrationConsecrationLevel 20 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantCost135 ManaCooldown8 sec cooldownDuration8 secConsecrates the land beneath the Paladin, doing 16 Holy damage over 8 sec to enemies who enter the area. The first 4 enemies who enter the area will take an additional 32 damage over 8 sec. at 20 changes the class from single-target to area-capable, and every spec now gets it. Budget mana for it.
  • JudgementJudgementLevel 4 · Spell · HolyCastInstantCost6% of base ManaRange10 yd rangeCooldown10 sec cooldownUnleash the energy of a Seal spell upon an enemy. Does not consume the Seal. Refer to individual Seals for Judgement effect. is a ranged attack since November 11. Blizzard changed it so it no longer counts as a melee attack for item and effect procs, and it uses your ranged hit chance. It still takes no global cooldown, so press it alongside another button.

Blizzard's dive closes by calling all three specs playable at the top: effective tanks, competitive damage dealers, the strongest single-target healers. It publishes no level-60 numbers behind that. The spec pages carry the builds, their dates and where the two sites disagree.
